A three-part flowchart showing the modern scope of agriculture. Left panel (Production): A farmer harvesting fresh cassava tubers from the soil. Middle panel (Processing): A woman frying grated cassava in a wide pan to make garri. Right panel (Marketing): A neatly packaged bag of garri being sold to a customer in a supermarket. Arrows link the panels.

A circular concept map with "Agriculture" in the centre. Branches radiate outwards: Agronomy (icon of a maize plant), Animal Husbandry (icon of a cow), Veterinary Medicine (icon of a syringe/cross), Agricultural Engineering (icon of a tractor), Agricultural Economics (icon of a chart with a naira ₦ symbol), Fishery (icon of a fish), Forestry (icon of a tree).

A split illustration comparing Subsistence and Commercial farming. Left half (Subsistence): A Nigerian farmer in simple clothes using a hand hoe on a small, mixed crop plot of maize and cassava. A small mud storage hut is in the background. Right half (Commercial): A vast, flat field entirely planted with a single crop (maize). A large green tractor with a plough is working the land, and large metal storage silos are in the distance.
